ai_applicability.broker_scan_crawling: Not a fit for on-device/local-model inference. Visiting 44 external broker sites requires a real rendered browser session (JS execution, CAPTCHA handling) — Playwright-class automation. This must remain server-side regardless of the local-model requirement; a phone-local model has no role here beyond optionally summarizing results already fetched from the server.
ai_applicability.scam_call_text_triage: Strong fit. Input is short (call transcript excerpt / SMS text), output is a classification + risk score, the task is latency-sensitive (warning needed during/right after a call) and privacy-sensitive (call content ideally never leaves the device). This is the original ANCHOR/SENTINEL/SCOUT concept from CORTEGE's web app, scoped to a single on-device model.
ai_applicability.exposure_summarization: Low-stakes, optional fit. Turning already-fetched broker-scan JSON into a plain-language summary ('exposed on 6 of 44 sites') is nice-to-have for offline use and avoiding an API call, but broker listings are public data — not privacy-sensitive — so a server-side Claude call works equally well and is higher quality.

risk_assessment.risk: On-device model quality gap on nuanced/novel scam patterns
risk_assessment.note: Small local models are materially weaker than a full Claude call at subtle fraud reasoning. False negatives on real fraud detection are the dangerous failure mode, not false positives.

iOS on-device Foundation Models and Android Gemini Nano/AICore both require newer OS versions and, on Android, largely flagship-only hardware. A large share of the Android install base would get a degraded or absent feature.

risk_assessment.risk: Scope creep back toward the full CORTEGE platform
risk_assessment.note: Reintroducing scam/fraud call analysis directly re-opens the 'scope too broad' criticism from the prior judged round if it's bolted onto the WARDEN broker-scan app rather than being a deliberate, separate product decision.
Bundled or downloaded model weights add app size, versioning, and evaluation burden beyond a typical CRUD mobile app.
On-device call/SMS analysis intersects with platform privacy and call-handling review (e.g. iOS CallKit/Call Directory extension limits) and can slow store approval.

alternatives: Hybrid triage: on-device model does a fast first-pass ('does this look suspicious?'); ambiguous cases get an opt-in escalation to the cloud Claude call for deeper analysis. Bounds privacy exposure while keeping quality on hard cases.

Defer local-model entirely for v1: ship the already-scoped WARDEN broker-scan app (free scan + paid monitoring, server-side) as planned, and treat on-device scam detection as an explicit v2/separate product decision rather than blocking v1 on a harder ML problem.

Scope local-model to the low-stakes task only: use it for plain-language exposure summarization (where a wrong output isn't dangerous) and keep anything safety-critical (actual scam/fraud judgment) server-side with Claude.
